title: Solutions Architect - MENA
description_html:
Company Overview

Deepgram is the leading platform underpinning the emerging trillion-dollar Voice AI economy, providing real-time APIs for speech-to-text (STT), text-to-speech (TTS), and building production-grade voice agents at scale. More than 200,000 developers and 1,300+ organizations build voice offerings that are ‘Powered by Deepgram’, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Daily, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box. Deepgram’s voice-native foundation models are accessed through cloud APIs or as self-hosted and on-premises software, with unmatched accuracy, low latency, and cost efficiency. Backed by a recent Series C led by leading global investors and strategic partners, Deepgram has processed over 50,000 years of audio and transcribed more than 1 trillion words. There is no organization in the world that understands voice better than Deepgram.

Company Operating Rhythm

At Deepgram, we expect an AI-first mindset—AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance.

Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. We measure how effectively AI is applied to deliver results, and consistent, creative use of the latest AI capabilities is key to success here. Candidates should be comfortable adopting new models and modes quickly, integrating AI into their workflows, and continuously pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can do.

Additionally, we move at the pace of AI. Change is rapid, and you can expect your day-to-day work to evolve just as quickly. This may not be the right role if you’re not excited to experiment, adapt, think on your feet, and learn constantly, or if you’re seeking something highly prescriptive with a traditional 9-to-5.

The Opportunity

Deepgram is investing in Arabic-language capabilities, and the customers who are building on them deserve a technical partner who speaks the language and knows the region firsthand. We are hiring an Applied Engineer to be that partner: the first member of our Applied Engineering team who is dedicated to Arabic-speaking markets. We would love for you to be based in the Middle East and North Africa (MENA), and the search is open across the broader EMEA region.

You'll operate in the Solutions Architect role, leading the technical design and delivery of customer implementations across MENA, from kickoff through production cutover. Because you'll be the first dedicated technical presence in the region, you'll also take a strong share of pre-sales work, including the technical discovery, proof-of-concepts, and evaluations that earn the technical win for regional prospects. You'll represent Deepgram in front of customers and at regional events, and you'll bring what you learn back to our Product and Research teams, including how our Arabic models perform across dialects in production.

The region's time zones overlap fully with EMEA business hours, so you'll work alongside our EMEA Applied Engineers every day, and you'll help to extend coverage toward APAC hours as the team grows.

About the Solutions Architect Role at Deepgram

Solutions Architects at Deepgram own the periods when a customer's environment is changing (a new onboarding, a scaling deployment, a migration, a feature rollout). The work is hands-on and technical. You'll design solutions that fit each customer's stack and constraints, drive the deployment work itself, and turn what each engagement teaches you into reusable patterns that compress how long it takes the next customer to reach value. In this seat, the motion extends into pre-sales. For many regional prospects, you'll be the first Deepgram engineer that they meet, and the same skills that make implementations succeed (listening well, designing to constraints, showing working software) also win evaluations.

You'll be hired into the Applied Engineer position on our Applied Engineering team, which combines what other companies split into Sales Engineering, Solutions Architecture, Implementation, Forward-Deployed Engineering, and Technical Support, with a single growth ladder from Associate through Principal. The region is your focus; Applied Engineering is where you grow.

What You'll Do

  • Own the technical design and delivery of customer implementations across MENA, from kickoff through production cutover

  • Lead technical discovery, proof-of-concept design, and evaluations for regional prospects, partnering with Account Executives through the sales cycle

  • Design solutions that fit each customer's stack, constraints, and data-residency requirements

title: Director – International Relations and Diplomacy Programs
salary_basis: Based on historical internship stipend records at Schiller International University
description_html:
Your mission

The Director of International Relations and Diplomacy (IRD) Programs, based at the Paris Campus, will provide academic leadership for Schiller International University’s undergraduate, graduate and online International Relations and Diplomacy programs across all campuses. The Director will be responsible for ensuring program currency and curriculum quality, faculty hiring and performance, and achieving student outcomes within the International Relations and Diplomacy discipline. In addition, the Director will provide Academic Leadership at the Paris Campus for all academic programs.
  
 The role encompasses the oversight of program design, curriculum development, course content, syllabi, course delivery, assessment and continuous improvement processes, ensuring compliance with U.S. accreditation standards, local regulatory requirements, and dual-degree and articulation agreements with various partners. The Director will work closely with academic leaders across campuses to recruit, evaluate, and support faculty teaching International Relations and Diplomacy courses, ensuring consistency in academic standards and learning outcomes throughout the institution. The director will also work with academic team, student experience and data team to monitor key performance indicators and help design interventions to ensure achieving student outcomes set by the university.
  
 In collaboration with Associate Deans, Directors of other academic areas, and the Paris Campus Director, the Director of International Relations and Diplomacy Programs will provide academic leadership for the Paris Campus and oversee faculty hiring and management, course allocations and academic operation. 
 
The successful candidate will work closely with faculty, staff, and other university stakeholders to foster student engagement, academic success, preparation for employment and career success, and deliver a transformative, student-centered educational experience aligned with Schiller’s experiential and challenge-based learning model.


Tasks and Responsabilities

  • Lead International Relations and Diplomacy programs design, review, and continuous improvement in collaboration with Academic team and other university offices. 
  • Participate in the review and assessment of program and course learning outcomes for International Relations and Diplomacy and other academic areas.
  • Engage actively in innovation within the area(s) of knowledge to update teaching and learning methodologies and educational technology in collaboration with the Educational Technology team and industry professionals.
  • Assess instructional needs and lead the effort to identify, hire and assign qualified faculty to all International Relations and Diplomacy courses across campuses in collaboration academic leaders on other campuses in a timely manner.
  • Collaborate with academic leaders on other campuses to identify, hire and assign qualified faculty to all courses on the Paris campus in a timely manner.
  • Lead annual evaluations of faculty in IRD across campuses and contribute to faculty annual performance evaluations at the Paris campus. 
  • Conduct course observations as needed, both online and onsite. 
  • Collaborate with the Educational Technology team to offer faculty development activities.
  • Support the growing Distance Learning Master’s program in International Relations and Diplomacy.
  • Collaborate with Dean of Institutional Effectiveness to ensure program quality and compliance with all regulations and accreditation requirements. 
  • Monitor student outcomes data weekly and to identify students at risk. Work with faculty and student services to design interventions to support their retention and success.
  • Collaborate with Employability team and devise and implement measures and initiatives to boost students’ employability and career success. 
  • Coordinate the effective implementation of VLE templates and uniform content within International Relations and Diplomacy offerings.
  • Manage faculty workload and faculty assignment in collaboration with the other academic leaders.
  • Any other duties assigned by the Provost, President or Campus Director.


Your Profile

  • An earned Doctorate degree in International Relations and Diplomacy or related field from an accredited institution or close to completion.
  • Proven experience and demonstrated excellence in higher education, administration, and industry experience.
  • Academic program design and review and managing faculty and staff.
  • Passion and commitment to student support and success.
  • Knowledge and experience in distant leaning and online instruction.
  • Knowledge of the American and/or French higher education systems is a plus.
  • Either native English speaker or proficiency level of English competency
  • Local language (French, German, Spanish), desirable
Competencies
  • Communication Connection and Service 
  • Global Mindset 
  • Achieving Results 
  • Driving Innovation and Managing Change 
  • Learning and Development 
  • Drives Vision and Leads Courageously
  • Strong focus on quality and continuous improvement 
  • Leadership skills 
  • Strong intercultural communication skills and cultural agility

description_html:

Wir schaffen Relevanz, um Aufmerksamkeit zu erreichen und zu skalieren.

Sichtbarkeit ist nicht automatisch Relevanz. Reichweite nicht automatisch Wirkung.

WeCreate ist eine Social-First Brand Building Agency für das Interest-Media-Zeitalter. Wir übersetzen Social Signals und Community Insights in Social Strategien, Content-Systeme und messbare Markenwirkung – als strategischer Partner, Campaign Co-Pilot oder operatives Umsetzungsteam.

Deine Rolle

Du verantwortest die strategische und kreative Gesamtausrichtung komplexer Kunden-Mandate von der Social Marken-Positionierung über Plattform- und Kanalstrategien bis zur übergreifenden Content-Systematik und Qualitätssicherung über alle Projektphasen hinweg.

Dabei arbeitest du eigenständig auf Senior-Level, triffst Entscheidungen mit hohem Gestaltungsspielraum und kommunizierst sicher mit den Marken-Entscheider:innen.   • Systemische Zusammenarbeit und Weiterentwicklung: Du arbeitest eng mit Social-, Creator-, Community-, Production- und Paid-Teams zusammen, begleitest relevante Produktionen und Offsites und entwickelst interne Prozesse sowie KI-gestützte Arbeitsweisen weiter.   • Du kannst komplexe Marken- und Business-Herausforderungen in klare strategische Positionierungen, kreative Leitideen und umsetzbare Content-Systeme übersetzen.

  • Du denkst strategisch und kreativ zugleich und verlierst dabei weder die Marke noch die Plattform oder die Umsetzbarkeit aus dem Blick.

Flexibilität mit Verbindung

  • Hybrides Arbeiten mit unserem Office in Hamburg als Team-Hub

  • Mindestens fünf Tage pro Monat gemeinsames Arbeiten im Office für integrierte Teamarbeit

  • Flexibles Arbeiten von zuhause und wenn du Lust auf einen Perspektivwechsel hast, nach Absprache zeitweise aus dem Ausland

  • Freie Wahl deiner Hardware

title: Senior Project Manager (m/f/d)

description_html:
Role description

As Senior Project Manager, you will join our central Project Management team in Reinbek, which leads the company's large and complex cross-functional projects and sets the standards for how projects are run across all of arethia's global locations. Join us during a pivotal growth phase and help create the foundations of a team that will drive meaningful transformation across the organisation.

You will independently lead complex projects with senior stakeholders across departments, and you will be the person we turn to when a project has drifted off course and needs to be brought back on track. 

This is a delivery role first, and it is also a chance to shape how project management works in a growing, international company: you will contribute to our standards and methods, support colleagues who run their own projects and help build a project management community across our sites. As the team grows, so does the scope of what you can take on.


Your Mission

  • Project Leadership – Lead large, cross-functional projects independently from initiation to closure, including planning, governance, steering committees and stakeholder management.
  • Problem Solving - Facilitate and actively participate in problem-solving sessions to drive project success 
  • Project Recovery – Take over projects that have drifted off course or lost their lead, diagnose what went wrong and re-establish structure as interim or permanent lead.
  • Stakeholder Management – Navigate demanding situations with senior leadership and across departments and prepare well-founded decisions for steering committees.
  • Quality and Coaching – Support department-led projects as quality assurance and sparring partner and coach project managers on their deliverables.
  • Standards and Methods – Contribute to our project management standards, templates and training formats, and turn project experience into reusable methods.


Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • Several years of experience independently leading complex, cross-functional projects with full ownership from initiation to closure.
  • Experience working with senior stakeholders and navigating conflicting interests across departments.
  • Strong analytical and problem solving skills.
  • Experience taking over or stabilising projects already in progress.
  • Ability to work independently, propose solutions and make decisions within your remit.
  • Business-level communication skills in German and English (C1).
  • Experience in applying common project management tools, e.g. for task and milestone tracking.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with an ERP or comparable large-scale system implementation.
  • IPMA Level C or equivalent. A higher level is a plus.
  • Experience in a manufacturing or regulated production environment.
  • Experience developing project management standards, templates or training formats.
  • Experience with Jira and Confluence.
  • Experience working in an international, multi-site organisation.


Why you'll love working here

  • Attraktive Aufgaben in einem international agierenden, wachsenden Familienunternehmen mit flachen Hierarchien
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten und Homeoffice-Möglichkeiten 
  • 4 Wochen Remote Work aus dem EU Ausland
  • 30 Tage bezahlter Urlaub pro Jahr
  • Gehaltsbänder für eine gerechte Unternehmenskultur
  • Monatlicher Zuschuss von 50€ für deine BAV
  • Teilnahme an jährlichen 360° Feedback-Loops mit klaren Aufstiegskriterien und einem individuellen Karrierepfad
  • Verantwortung ab dem ersten Tag in einem Unternehmen, das Eigenverantwortung und persönliches Wachstum fördert
  • Im Bedarfsfall können Umzugskosten anteilig erstattet werden
  • Regelmäßige Firmenevents wie Sommerfest, Weihnachtsfeier
  • Zwei Mal im Jahr bezahlte Teamdinner oder -aktivitäten für jedes Team
  • Kostenloser Parkplatz direkt vor der Tür
  • Vergünstigungen und Benefits: JobRad, subventioniertes Mittagessen, Zuschuss zum Deutschlandticket, kostenlose Sprachkurse, sowie attraktive Konditionen für Mitgliedschaften in Fitnessstudios und dem Wellpass
  • Frisches Obst, kostenlose Getränke und Snacks im Büro

title: Sales Development Representative - EMEA

description_html:
About AirOps

AirOps is the full-service platform for brand growth in the age of AI search. As consumers shift from traditional search engines to platforms like ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini, the entire ruleset of growth is being rewritten. Buyers now rely on agents to discover, recommend, and purchase products and services for them. If your brand isn't part of the answer, you aren't in the running.

Our platform offers everything a brand needs to get found, recommended, and earn trust. We work with category leaders, including teams at Ramp, Chime, Airbnb, ServiceNow, and Rippling, to drive visibility and accelerate growth from AI search.

Backed by Greylock, Unusual Ventures, Wing VC, and Founder Collective, we're headquartered in San Francisco, New York, and Montevideo.

About the Role:

AirOps is opening its first dedicated EMEA sales development role at a moment when AI-driven content discovery is reshaping how European brands compete. You will own the full outbound motion across EMEA, prospecting into marketing and growth teams in the UK, DACH, Nordics, Benelux, France, Southern Europe, and beyond. This is not a UK-only seat.

You will build pipeline across multiple markets, navigating different buying cultures and business contexts every day. You'll work cross-functionally with Sales and GTM Engineering to turn intent signals into qualified discovery calls that map prospect pain to our AI capabilities. Based hybrid out of our central London office, you are the first face of AirOps for EMEA buyers. The role reports into our Sales leadership and carries a direct line to how quickly we scale internationally. If you want a front-row seat to building a region from scratch, this is it.

 

What you'll own:

  • Build the Engine: As one of the founding EMEA SDRs, you'll develop and execute creative outreach strategies that don't just hit targets, they crush them. You'll be the one finding the "needles in the haystack" and turning them into qualified pipeline.

  • Be an AI Matchmaker: Conduct discovery calls that act as deep-dive consultations. Your goal is to map prospect pain points to our AI capabilities, not just read a script.

  • Own the First Impression: You are the first face of AirOps. You’ll build authentic, high-trust relationships with key decision-makers before they even realize they need a better workflow.

  • Pass the Torch: Work in lockstep with our Account Executives to ensure that every handoff is seamless, qualified, and set up for a closed-won win.

  • The "Data Artist": Keep our CRM (our "Source of Truth") clean, organized, and actionable. We value data-driven iteration—if an email template isn't working, iterate, A/B test, and optimize until it does.

  • Startup Speed: In a high-growth environment, agility is your superpower. Whether you're troubleshooting a new outreach tool or jumping on a last-minute demo, you thrive on the "all-hands-on-deck" pace.

 

What you'll bring:

  • The "Hungry" Factor: 0-1 years of B2B SaaS sales experience. If you’ve got the grit, we’ll provide the roadmap. Bonus points if you’ve spent time in the marketing or growth-tech trenches.

  • Outreach Ninja: Whether it's a cold call, a hyper-personalized email, or a strategic LinkedIn connection, you know how to cut through the noise without sounding like a bot.

  • High EQ & Active Listening: You know that discovery is 80% listening and 20% speaking. You have the empathy to understand a prospect's frustrations and the communication skills to offer the solution.

  • Bias for Action: You are just as comfortable running solo on a new project as you are jumping into a team brainstorming session. You own your outcomes.

  • A Track Record of "Done": Whether it’s a side project, a degree, or a previous job, you have a history of starting things and actually finishing them.

  • The Vibe-Coder Mindset: We build with AI, and we want you to understand it. Experience coding, scripting, or playing around with "vibe-coding" platforms (Claude Code, Cursor, Lovable, etc.) is a massive plus. You don't need to be a software engineer, but you've ideally gone beyond simply using LLMs as research and content-generation tools.

  • Nice to have: Fluent in a European language beyond English. German, French, Spanish, Dutch, or a Nordic language would open doors across key EMEA markets.

Compensation Band: £65-80K OTE [60/40]

 

By submitting this application, I consent to AirOps, Inc. processing my personal data for the purposes of this recruitment process. I understand I may withdraw this consent at any time by contacting ----- />
AirOps' candidate privacy policy notice here

Our Guiding Principles

  1. Extreme Ownership

  2. Quality

  3. Curiosity and Play

  4. Make Our Customers Heroes

  5. Respectful Candor

Benefits

  • Equity in a fast-growing startup

  • Competitive benefits package tailored to your location

  • Flexible time off policy

  • Parental Leave

  • A fun-loving and (just a bit) nerdy team that loves to move fast!

title: Partner Marketing Manager EMEA- Growth
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Sitecore
description_html:
About Us:

At Sitecore, our mission is to simplify how brands reach, engage, and serve people by delivering intelligent, personalised digital experiences that connect the world. We empower the world’s most iconic brands to build lifelong relationships with their customers—seamlessly, smartly, and at scale.

As the leading provider of agentic digital experience software, Sitecore brings together content, commerce, and data into one composable platform that enables brands to deliver millions of meaningful, adaptive experiences every day. Trusted by global leaders such as American Express, Porsche, Starbucks, and L’Oréal, Sitecore helps brands transform engagement through experiences that are not only personalised but predictive and dynamic.

Our foundation is our people—a diverse, passionate, and collaborative global team spanning over 25 countries. We believe that every experience matters, and that belief starts with how we work together. Our values—empathy, accountability, clarity, and growth—guide how we lead, innovate, and connect. They are the behaviours that bring our mission and vision to life, every day, in every interaction.

As we continue to evolve, we are actively cultivating AI skills across our teams to unlock new levels of creativity, efficiency, and insight. From engineering to customer experience, AI capabilities are becoming integral to how we design, build, and deliver the next generation of digital experiences.

Learn more at Sitecore.com.

About the Role:

This is a rare opportunity to shape how Sitecore grows through its partner ecosystem across two of its most dynamic regions. The Partner Marketing Manager owns joint marketing with Sitecore's implementation partners across EMEA and Asia Pacific, as well as our international reseller community—turning those relationships into a powerful, scalable route to market.

You will build and run co-marketing programmes that are deliberately aligned to Sitecore's core FY27 buying motions— including our market-leading CMS SitecoreAI, our AI-powered DAM and Scrunch, the best way to win AI search. Every campaign you launch will be tied to a business problem our customers are actively trying to solve, and to the pipeline and bookings that follow.

The role blends ambitious strategic thinking with confident hands-on delivery. You will work shoulder to shoulder with partners, regional sales leaders and the wider marketing organisation to extend Sitecore's reach through and with our ecosystem, and you will see the impact of your work in the pipeline, in partner momentum, and in the customers we win together. You will take on a broad and genuinely influential remit across EMEA, Asia Pacific and our international reseller network:

What You Will Do:

  • Align partner marketing to the FY27 buying motions: Translate Sitecore's buying motions into partner-ready campaigns, narratives and assets, ensuring every parent campaign is correctly aligned and consistently tracked

  • Build joint plans with EMEA and APAC implementation partners: Develop and manage ambitious quarterly marketing plans with our systems integrators and implementation partners, using multi-channel tactics—webinars, events, digital campaigns, executive roundtables—to create demand and pipeline in-region

  • Support our growing international reseller business: Design scalable, repeatable marketing programmes and campaign-in-a-box toolkits that equip resellers across international markets to generate and progress demand independently, with the messaging, enablement and support they need to succeed

  • Drive pipeline and revenue through the channel: Align every partner programme to regional sales objectives, generating new-customer leads, accelerating pipeline and contributing directly to bookings targets for Sitecore's core and new offers

  • Develop and champion partner relationships: Build trusted, energising relationships with key partners and reseller leaders. Work closely with partner account managers to spot joint opportunities, shape go-to-market programmes and keep partners engaged, informed and invested

  • Coordinate across regions and functions: Partner with Field Marketing, Corporate Marketing, Product Marketing, Campaigns and Sales across EMEA and Asia Pacific to adapt global content for partner use, respecting local market nuance while keeping messaging consistent and on-brand

  • Measure, learn and report: Track programme performance against clear KPIs, analyse results across campaigns, regions and channels to determine ROI and best practice, and share regular, insight-rich reporting with internal stakeholders and partners alike

  • Manage budget and Marketing Development Funds: Own the partner marketing budget, including MDF and co-op funds, allocating investment to the partners, markets and motions with the greatest potential for return

What You Need to Succeed:

  • A minimum of 5 years of B2B marketing experience, including direct experience with partner or channel marketing programmes in the technology or software industry

  • Experience marketing across multiple international markets—EMEA and/or Asia Pacific especially—with genuine sensitivity to cultural and market differences

  • Confidence building campaigns around solution and outcome-led themes rather than product features

  • Demand generation and account-based marketing (ABM) skills

  • An analytical and data-driven mindset

  • Marketing technology proficiency: familiarity with modern marketing tools and platforms is required, including CRM software such as Salesforce, marketing automation platforms, web analytics tools, content management systems, and business intelligence dashboards

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the credibility to influence senior partner and internal stakeholders

  • Strategic and creative thinking, paired with the drive to deliver hands-on

Additional Skills That Could Set You Apart

  • Experience working with global or regional DXP systems integrators and implementation partners

  • Experience building reseller or distributor marketing programmes at scale

  • Familiarity with Sitecore or other martech and digital experience products

  • Understanding of AI-led marketing use cases, including AI search visibility and digital asset management

Equal Opportunities at Sitecore

Sitecore is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. We are committed to equal employment opportunity without unlawful regard to race, colour, ancestry, religion, gender, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, veteran status or any other local legally protected characteristic.

title: Senior Product Designer, Badoo
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Bumble Inc.
description_html:
Introduction to Role & Team

Badoo is one of the world's largest dating apps, connecting millions of people across the globe. It's a mature, much-loved product with enormous reach, and we're in the middle of an ambitious chapter: modernising the experience, sharpening how we help members find real connections, and building a healthier, more sustainable business.

As a Senior Product Designer on Badoo, you'll help shape that next chapter. You'll take end-to-end ownership of meaningful surfaces - onboarding, people discovery, chatting,, and the monetisation experiences that sit alongside them - designing for a global, diverse, and value-conscious membership. This is high-craft product design under real-world constraints: a lean, fast-moving team, an experiment-led culture, and a design foundation we're actively rebuilding.

You'll be a key voice at the intersection of product, engineering, research, and data - balancing sharp product thinking and strong craft with commercial pragmatism and a deep respect for the people who use Badoo. If you're energised by scale, comfortable making trade-offs explicit, and want your work to move both member and business outcomes, this is a rare canvas to work on.

What You’ll Do

  • Own end-to-end design for multiple Badoo surfaces leading the work from discovery and problem framing through interaction design, visual polish, and delivery.

  • Design experiences that balance member value with commercial impact: paywalls, consumables and subscription flows that feel fair and clear. Monetisation is central to Badoo's roadmap, and great design is what makes it work for members and the business.

  • Work in an experiment-led way. Most meaningful changes ship as A/B tests with clear hypotheses and guardrails, so you'll design for iteration and learning, not just a single polished hand-off, and stay close to the results.

  • Help modernise Badoo's design foundations. Our design system is a work in progress; you'll contribute patterns and components that raise consistency and quality across a large, mature product.

  • Collaborate closely with PMs, UXR, data science, and engineers to frame problems, validate hypotheses, synthesise insights, and evolve designs based on evidence, accepting that data is sometimes imperfect and that judgment matters.

  • Ship pragmatically within a lean team. Prioritise for member and business outcomes over perfection, make trade-offs explicit, and know when to push for the ideal experience and when to ship a well-reasoned version.

  • Design for a global, inclusive audience - a diverse international membership across many markets, languages, and devices - and for platform and compliance requirements as they evolve.

  • Apply AI-powered tools and methods to accelerate exploration, improve accessibility, and personalise experiences responsibly.

  • Give and receive design critique with precision and care while elevating the work around you and modelling a culture of high craft standards.

  • Model Bumble’s core competencies: collaborate with purpose, take ownership, adapt with agility, and deliver from insight to impact.

  • Embody our values of Courage, Respect, and Joy in how you work and the experiences you create.

About You

  • You’re an experienced end-to-end product designer with a track record of delivering thoughtful, high-quality mobile experiences from ambiguity to release.

  • You have a strong product mind: you frame problems before jumping to solutions, connect design decisions to user and business outcomes, and think in systems as much as screens.

  • You're commercially fluent and comfortable designing monetisation experiences that feel fair, and are a well-crafted part of the product rather than a bolt-on.

  • You thrive with constraints. You're pragmatic about scope, comfortable in a lean and fast-moving team, and energised by working on a mature product that needs modernising.

  • You're at home in an experiment-driven environment: designing for A/B tests, iterating on results, and reasoning under uncertainty in a two-sided marketplace where impact is hard to predict.

  • Your visual and interaction design craft is strong, your work is polished, considered, and reflects a deep understanding of what makes digital experiences feel right.

  • You bring real intentionality to your process: from how you frame a problem to how you design a transition, your work shows rigour, purpose, and care.

  • You balance user empathy with commercial pragmatism and know when to push for the ideal experience and when to ship a well-reasoned version.

  • You’re fluent in Figma and modern prototyping tools and you use them to think as well as to communicate.

  • You’re grounded in inclusive design principles and accessibility standards, and you bring a global mindset to your work.

  • You’re curious about AI’s role in product experiences and you apply these tools with ethical care and creative intention.

  • You take full ownership of your work: you drive things to a conclusion, communicate proactively, and build trust with partners across disciplines.

  • Typically requires 5-8 years of experience, though we welcome candidates with alternative backgrounds that demonstrate equivalent skills.

 

✨ Kind, curious, and low-ego designers thrive at Bumble Inc. If you’re excited to shape how people around the world form relationships and find belonging, we’d love to hear from you.

Benefits & Perks

  • Annual personal learning & development budget

  • Private Medical Insurance (PMI)

  • Private Dental Insurance

  • Babylon Health app

  • Mental health support

  • Enhanced parental leave, including a highly competitive maternity package

  • Unlimited PTO

  • Subsidised gym membership

  • ‘Double matched’ pension contributions up to 6%

  • Premium App Access

About Us

Bumble Inc. is the parent company of Bumble Date, BFF, and Badoo. The Bumble platform enables people to build healthy and equitable relationships, through Kind Connections. Founded by Whitney Wolfe Herd in 2014, Bumble was one of the first dating apps built with women at the center and connects people across dating (Bumble Date) and friendship (BFF). BFF is a friendship app where people in all stages of life can meet people nearby and create meaningful platonic connections and community based on shared interests. Badoo, which was founded in 2006, is one of the pioneers of web and mobile dating products.

AI Fluency

AI is important to us. We’re excited by people who are curious and experimental, and who think thoughtfully about how AI can amplify their impact and outcomes.

We encourage you to use AI responsibly as you prepare your application. Please don’t use it to fabricate experiences or answer questions live in interviews. We care deeply about authenticity and want to understand your real skills, judgment and voice, because building a meaningful, genuine connection with you matters to us.

Final Compensation

Will be determined based on factors such as the selected candidate’s qualifications, relevant experience, skill set, and other job-related considerations.

Inclusion at Bumble Inc.

Bumble Inc. is an equal opportunity employer and we strongly encourage people of all ages, color, lesbian, gay, bisexual, transgender, queer and non-binary people, veterans, parents, people with disabilities, and neurodivergent people to apply. We're happy to make any reasonable adjustments that will help you feel more confident throughout the process, please don't hesitate to let us know how we can help.

In your application, please feel free to note which pronouns you use (For example: she/her, he/him, they/them, etc).

AI in Bumble Inc. Hiring

At Bumble, we may use AI tools to support parts of our recruitment process — such as helping us record, transcribe, and summarize conversations, and supporting job alignment by comparing resumes and job descriptions to highlight skills and potential roles that may be a good match. These tools help us work more efficiently and stay focused on you during our conversations. Importantly, all hiring decisions are made by people. AI is used only to support our team’s efficiency and improve the candidate experience — not to evaluate or decide on your candidacy. Participation in AI-supported interviews and conversations is completely voluntary and will not impact your candidacy. If you’d prefer to opt out, simply let your recruiter or interviewer know at the start of a call, or anytime during the interview or conversation. Summaries and related data are retained only as long as needed in line with our internal data retention policies. If at any point you’d like a transcription or summary deleted, please contact your recruiter directly.

Fraudulent Candidate Detection

Our applicant tracking system analyzes signals relating to device, IP, email, and phone data associated with each application to protect applicants and our hiring process from fraudulent applications. These signals provide indicators for internal review only and do not constitute a definitive determination of identity or intent. No applicant is rejected, advanced, or otherwise affected based solely on this analysis without human review

For further information on how we hold and manage your data, please refer to our Privacy Policy.

title: 2D Graphic/Product Designer (Softlines & Kids Accessories) (all genders)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Tonies
description_html:
About tonies:

tonies is the world’s leading interactive audio platform for children, with over 12 million Tonieboxes and 165 million Tonies sold globally. Our intuitive, screen-free system empowers children to learn and play independently in a safe and engaging way.


With a presence in over 100 countries and a diverse portfolio of ~1,500 Tonies across multiple languages, we continue to redefine how children experience storytelling and learning. Since our IPO in 2021, our global team of 630+ colleagues is united by a shared mission: shaping the future of play, learning, and imagination.


You as part of tonies:

We're looking for an experienced Graphic/Visual Designer to own the design output of the tonies Accessories portfolio. Reporting to the Director of Accessories, you'll be responsible for CMF direction across all categories, 2D asset creation, product renders, licensor approval submissions, and Style Guide stewardship. You'll work within a structured product development process (PDP), holding the Responsible role across various design tasks — from initial ideation through to golden sample approval.

This is a role for someone who thinks in finished products that excite our target audiences, not just finished files. You understand that what you're designing will be held by a child, sitting on a shelf in a retailer in Germany, the US, or the UK, next to one of the most loved children's brands in the world. That context matters to you.


This role may NOT be a great fit if:
  • Your background is primarily in UI/UX, Web, or Digital Product Design.
  • Your experience is strictly in Hardlines or Industrial Hardware Design (e.g., plastic toys, consumer electronics, or pure hardware).   
  • You have no experience designing physical products aimed at kids, families, or youth lifestyle audiences.   
  • Your focus has been on managing external creative agencies or vendor design teams, rather than personally creating hands-on 2D production-ready artwork.


Your tasks and responsibilities will include:

Design ownership across the full PDP

  • Direct CMF (Color, Material, Finish) for all accessories categories — Headphones, Nightlights, Bags, Shelves, Decoration, and more.
  • Build design briefs for ODM/OEM manufacturing partners and own the construction sample process
  • Lead first sample and golden sample approvals against brand and CMF standards
  • Manage Top of Production (TOP) sample reviews and sign-off
  • Commission 3D packaging renders from supply partners and review against brand
Licensor management
  • Own the end-to-end licensor design submission process for all IP partnerships
  • Maintain the licensor submission tracker and ensure approvals stay on schedule
  • Build fluency with individual licensor style guides and maintain their application across the range
Brand stewardship
  • Own and maintain the Accessories Style Guides — the definitive brand reference for all categories
  • Ensure visual coherence across all accessories SKUs (across our entry, mid and premium tiers) in the annual pipeline with a distinctive connection with the broader tonies product ecosystem
  • Maintain and organise shared drive documentation (samples, approvals, asset files, product catalogue)
  • Work closely with external agencies and the brand creative teams to ensure alignment and brand integrity 
Cross-functional collaboration
  • Present design routes and options to Senior Product Managers who set commercial direction
  • Work in lockstep with the Senior Operations Lead on sample logistics, scheduling, and PDP coordination
  • Translate commercial briefs into executable design direction for manufacturing partners including our preferred outsourced operations partner. 


What we are looking for:

  • 5–7 years of product design, graphic/visual design or packaging design experience in consumer goods, accessories, lifestyle, or licensed products essential
  • Proven CMF direction experience across multiple product categories
  • Hands-on experience managing licensor approval loops with brand partners (entertainment, character, lifestyle IP)
  • Experience working with ODM/OEM supply chains — you know what a design brief needs to include for a manufacturer to execute it
  • Familiarity with a structured product development process (stage-gate, RACI-based, or similar)
  • Advanced Adobe Creative Suite proficiency (Illustrator, Photoshop) including production-ready artwork
  • Strong understanding of material and print processes — what a spec sheet needs to say, and why
  • English at a professional level; German is a strong plus
Nice to have:
  • 3D rendering capability (Keyshot, Rhino, or similar)
  • Experience designing within licensed brand style guides (entertainment IP, or similar)
  • Background in apparel, fashion & home accessories, or soft goods design (toys & consumer electronics is a plus)
  • Understanding of sustainable packaging and materials principles
  • Portfolio that demonstrates physical product development, not just graphic design


Why tonies?

●   Global Teamwork: We collaborate across departmental and country borders. You’ll be part of a truly international community where every voice is heard.
●   Come as you are: This applies to the dress code and everything else. We believe you give your best when you feel truly comfortable being yourself.
●   Competitive Package: We offer a competitive salary and a range of comprehensive benefits tailored to your specific location, which we’ll share during the recruiting process.
●   Collaboration & Community: We’re big on "we." You’ll join a team that values connection and celebrates wins together, no matter the time zone.
●   Continuous Learning: Benefit from internal/external training and an individual learning budget to keep your skills as sharp as a Tonie’s ears.
●   Tonie Discounts: Enjoy attractive discounts on our entire range of products. You’ll quickly become the favorite guest at every birthday party!
●   Rest & Recharge: Great work requires a clear head. You’ll enjoy generous paid time off to ensure you have plenty of time for your own stories.


Good to know:

Please submit your application documents in English.

As part of our principles, we are committed to supporting inclusion and diversity at tonies. We actively celebrate our colleagues’ different abilities, ethnicities, faith and gender. Everyone is welcome and supported in their development at all stages in their journey with us. 

We look forward to hearing from you!

title: Senior Management Accountant
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Vision RT Ltd.
description_html:
Vision RT is a fast-growing MedTech company transforming radiation therapy for cancer patients by helping make it more accurate, effective, and comfortable. The company is the inventor of, and a market leader in, Surface Guided Radiation Therapy (SGRT). This technology uses advanced 3D cameras to track surface data, providing enhanced guidance across every step of the radiotherapy workflow.
 
Our systems are used in over 3,000 clinics worldwide, including in 29 of the top 30 Best Hospitals for Cancer (source: US News and World Report 2026 rankings).
 
The company is recognized as one of Britain’s fastest-growing private tech companies, as featured in the 2025 Sunday Times 100 Tech list. Vision RT is also a recipient of the 2026 King’s Award for Enterprise, our fifth in 10 years. It is the UK’s most prestigious accolade for business excellence.
 
Company video
 
With around 400+ employees globally and offices in the UK, Poland, and the USA, Vision RT operates independently as part of the Danish company William Demant Invest A/S, one of the world’s largest investors in healthcare companies. Employees benefit from the security and reach of being part of a large global enterprise, combined with the agility and innovation of a startup.
 
Vision RT is a company with strong values, a clear mission, and a bright future. It is an exciting and rewarding organization in which to work.
 

About the role

We are seeking a highly motivated and detail-oriented Senior Management Accountant to join our finance team. This role plays a critical part in delivering accurate financial insights, supporting strategic decision-making, and driving business performance.

As a Senior Management Accountant, you will be responsible for preparing monthly management accounts, performing financial analysis, and partnering with key stakeholders across the business. You will ensure the integrity of financial reporting while identifying opportunities to improve processes, efficiency, and profitability.

Working closely with senior leadership, you will provide meaningful commentary on financial performance, budgets, and forecasts, helping to guide business strategy. This role also involves mentoring junior team members and contributing to the continuous development of the finance function. 

This is an excellent opportunity for a qualified accountant looking to take on a high-impact role within a dynamic and fast-paced environment.

Key responsibilities will include

• Preparing the monthly Management Accounts for subsidiaries. We currently have subsidiaries based in the UK, USA, Germany, China, Australia, Poland, India, Spain, Korea, Canada and Japan.
• Carrying out month-end tasks such as revenue recognition, cost of sales workings, accruals, prepayments, and maintenance of the fixed asset register.
• Balance Sheet reconciliations
• Bank reconciliations
• Debtor, creditor, and bank revaluations.
• Intercompany reconciliations
• Analyse the financial results to produce commentary for senior management for both internal and external reporting
• Carrying out project work such as improving files, systems, and processes.
• Responsible for VAT/GST Returns including any other Monthly/Quarterly local tax returns and ensure deadlines are always met
• Work with the local accountants/advisors to ensure the subsidiaries’ account balances are aligned with ours
• Responsible for any other applicable returns in the Subsidiaries as and when required
• Assist with the preparation and filing of the Statutory Accounts in the Subsidiary countries in line with IFRS/local GAAP requirements
• Assist with Year-End duties and annual audit
• Other ad hoc duties as and when required by the Financial Controller and Finance Director.

Essential Skills & Experience

• 5+ years of experience in an accounting environment, with knowledge of IFRS and UK GAAP
• Qualified Accountant
• International Experience
• Good Academics
• Month End Experience including Prepayments, Accruals, Revenue Recognition
• Strong analytical skills, with high attention to detail
• Good Excel skills including Vlookups, Pivot tables and Sumifs
• Able to work to strict deadlines
• Able to work independently and take the initiative in solving problems
• Solid understanding of basic accounting payable principles, including a good knowledge of VAT
• Proven ability to calculate, post and manage accounting figures and financial records
• Ability to communicate and work at all levels with a large number of stakeholders i.e. junior staff to senior management.

Desirable Skills & Experience

• Experience in leading teams and managing junior staff
• Experience using Sage 200, Credit Hound and TM1 – Apliqo
• Experience using Paperless
• Experience using WebExpenses
• Audit experience from a Big 4 or mid-tier firm

Vision RT is an Equal Opportunity / Affirmative Action employer, all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment and development without regard to race, colour, religion, sexual orientation, gender, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status.

title: Senior Hauptbuchhalter  (m/w/d)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at FINN
description_html:
Your Role
Als Senior Hauptbuchhalter (m/w/d) bist du das Rückgrat unseres Finanzwesens und treibst die Skalierbarkeit unserer Hauptbuchhaltung maßgeblich voran. In unserer modernen SAP S/4HANA-Umgebung übernimmst du die Verantwortung für komplexe Abschlussprozesse, sicherst eine makellose Datenqualität unserer Subsysteme und gestaltest Intercompany-Workflows. Mit deiner Accounting-Expertise transformierst du klassische Buchhaltung in hochautomatisierte, zukunftssichere Finanzprozesse und legst das Fundament für FINNs weltweites Wachstum.

Your Mission
  • Master the General Ledger: Du führst und stimmst die Hauptbücher eigenverantwortlich für ausgewählte Gesellschaften ab und garantierst eine lückenlose, rechtssichere Buchführung nach HGB.
  • Drive financial closings: Du treibst die Erstellung von Monats- und Jahresabschlüssen proaktiv voran und agierst als kompetente Schnittstelle bei Audits sowie steuerlichen Prüfungen.
  • Optimize data & automation: Du sicherst die Datenqualität zwischen operativen Subsystemen und dem Hauptbuch und hebst durch gezielte Kontrollen neue Automatisierungspotenziale.
  • Manage complex structures: Du betreust komplexe Finanzinstrumente und treibst Sonderprojekte, wie beispielsweise die Bilanzierung von ABS-Strukturen oder Forderungsverkäufen, erfolgreich voran.
  • Streamline intercompany workflows: Du verantwortest die reibungslose Abstimmung und Verrechnung zwischen unseren Gesellschaften und etablierst effiziente, konzernweite Finanzprozesse.
  • Ensure compliance & guidelines: Du stellst die strikte Einhaltung gesetzlicher Vorschriften sowie unserer internen Richtlinien sicher und agierst als verlässlicher Sparringspartner im Team.

    • Your Profile
    Must have: 
  • Fundierte Accounting-Expertise: Langjährige, praxiserprobte Berufserfahrung in der Hauptbuchhaltung (General Ledger), idealerweise erworben in einem dynamischen Finanzdienstleistungs-, Fintech- oder Scale-up-Umfeld.
  • Starke HGB- & Sonderstruktur-Kenntnisse: Fundiertes Fachwissen in der Bilanzierung nach HGB sowie nachweisbare Erfahrung in der Betreuung komplexer Finanzinstrumente (z. B. ABS-Strukturen oder Forderungsverkauf) gepaart mit einem passenden Studium oder einer Qualifikation als Bilanzbuchhalter (IHK).
  • System- & ERP-Affinität: Fundierte Erfahrung in der Anwendung und Optimierung moderner ERP-Systeme (vorzugsweise SAP S/4HANA) sowie eine stark analytische, strukturierte und zahlenaffine Arbeitsweise.

title: Principal Engineer - Autonomous Systems (m/f/d)

description_html:
What we offer

  • Work in an international, agile and ambitious team creating the future of autonomous systems
  • Grow your career in a expanding and ambitious engineering team
  • Build innovative products using state-of-the-art technologies in AI, robotics, and autonomy 
  • Benefit from a steep learning curve and continuous development
  • Enjoy team events and a strong, collaborative culture


Your mission

Join Autonomous Teaming Solutions and build next-generation autonomous robotic systems for demanding real-world environments. You will take end-to-end technical ownership and responsibility of a mission-critical robotics product where perception, system performance, and reliability directly impact operational success. 

As Principal Engineer, you carry overall technical responsibility. You have the final word on architecture, integration and deployment - and you carry the consequences when the system fails. No project manager above you. You decide, you deliver. You work directly with company leadership, not as a career step, but because you are the deepest technically. Your place is still in the team: building, not reporting.

  • You own a complex autonomous system end-to-end - from architecture to field deployment.
  • You build yourself solutions - every day, in the code, next to your team. With us, leading means going first.
  • You are the tiebreaker on technical decisions across all subsystems.
  • You cut whatever does not pay into the next milestone - before you optimize.
  • You test in the field, with measurable and clear pass/fail criteria.


Your profile

  • You are a builder. You have already put things into the world. Systems, products, projects with real users. Not just planned, not conceptualized: built.
  • You have built something of your own before: a company, a product, a project with no one standing behind you. You know what real responsibility feels like. 
  • Deep knowledge in real-time embedded systems, sensor fusion or perception. Proven by systems that run and make a difference. 
  • You have taken something from zero to running hard- and software solutions. Solely responsible, with numbers to show for it.
  • C++ and ROS2 under a latency budget is your terrain.
  • Your first reaction to a new requirement is to ask whether it can be dropped.
  • You have made engineers better by building next to them and coach them.
  • You build in your own time too, because you cannot do otherwise.


What else

  • Citizenship of a NATO member country or close ally.


Why us?

How we work

Clear ownership, everything else is bureaucracy. Every system has exactly one owner with the final word. No V-model, no phase gates, no sign-off meetings. Requirements get challenged, not worked through. Delete first, then simplify, then accelerate - in that order.

Our milestones are binary. Testing happens in the field, not in simulation.


What you get
  • Full technical authority over a system in active deployment.
  • Direct contact with the customer, no layers in between.
  • A team that owns the mission itself.
  • Munich, 5 days on-site. We build together.

No job for you if
  • You need three meetings before a decision gets made.
  • You want a title. What we hand out is the final word and full consequence.
  • A good design matters more to you than a running, functional system.

title: ML Data Engineer (m/f/d) - Sensor Data & Pipelines

description_html:
What we offer

  • Work in an international, agile team creating the future of autonomous systems
  • Grow your career in a expanding and ambitious engineering team
  • Build innovative products using state-of-the-art technologies in AI, robotics, and autonomy 
  • Benefit from a steep learning curve and continuous development
  • Enjoy team events and a strong, collaborative culture


Your mission

This role owns the data foundation of our perception systems end-to-end — the layer that directly determines model performance in real-world environments. You'll set the technical direction for how we collect, curate, and continuously improve the datasets behind object detection, working as a senior technical partner to ML, perception, and robotics teams — turning raw, messy sensor data into reliable, production-grade systems at scale.

You will take full ownership of the ML data lifecycle — from architecture decisions on ingestion and pipelines, through labeling strategy and QA, to driving continuous, metrics-informed dataset improvement — and will be expected to bring judgment and prior experience to how this is done, not just execute a defined process.



What you'll do:

  • Architect and own scalable pipelines for ingesting, organizing, and preprocessing large volumes of time-series camera and multi-sensor data (RGB, IR, thermal, depth, IMU)
  • Drive the strategy behind our object detection datasets, ensuring quality, diversity, and statistical representativeness at scale
  • Design and operate active learning loops that connect model performance directly to data selection and improvement priorities
  • Own labeling workflows end-to-end — tooling decisions, QA methodology, consistency standards, and coordination of annotation efforts
  • Partner closely with AI Engineers to diagnose model weaknesses, bias, and drift, and translate findings into concrete dataset strategy
  • Plan and lead data collection campaigns (field recordings, drone/video capture) to close gaps with high-value real-world data
  • Build internal tools and dashboards that give the org visibility into dataset quality, distribution, and performance gaps


Your profile

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in Python and data processing frameworks (Pandas, NumPy, vectorized operations, multiprocessing)
  • Proven track record building and owning ETL/ELT pipelines for large-scale video and sensor datasets in production
  • Deep experience with data orchestration and lifecycle management for ML/computer vision workflows, including dataset versioning and reproducibility
  • Strong command of object detection pipelines (Detectron2, MMDetection, COCO format, bounding-box standards)
  • Demonstrated experience designing active learning, uncertainty sampling, or semi-supervised dataset workflows
  • Deep familiarity with data annotation platforms (CVAT, Label Studio) and building automated QA/consistency checks
  • Strong grasp of evaluation metrics for object detection (IoU, mAP, precision-recall curves, class-wise metrics)
  • Comfortable owning decisions around databases (SQL/NoSQL), file systems, and large-scale image, video, and sensor dataset management
  • Track record of working cross-functionally and influencing perception, deployment, robotics, and data infrastructure teams
  • Fluent in English; German and/or French are a plus


Nice to have

  • Experience with cloud storage and MLOps tools (AWS S3, MinIO, ClearML, MLFlow, Weights & Biases).
  • Familiarity with ROS / robotics data formats (bag files, TF trees, sensor_msgs), Docker, or embedded ML workflows.
  • Prior work with robotics, drones, or multi-sensor perception systems, including IR, LiDAR, radar, or audio datasets.


What else

  • Outside-the-box creativity with a blend of conceptual and systematic design thinking.
  • High intrinsic motivation, attention to detail, and strong problem-solving mindset.
  • Structured, methodical, and reliable execution, even under uncertainty.
  • Humble, collaborative, and mission-driven — values collective success over ego.
  • High ethical standards and disciplined work ethic.
  • Extra-curricular achievements, leadership, or unique projects are a plus.
  • NATO-aligned nationality or close ally citizenship is required.


Why us?

Join us to shape the future of AI-driven defense!

Du übernimmst die fachliche Führung der AP/AR-Accountants und arbeitest eng mit Controlling, Treasury, Steuerberatern und Wirtschaftsprüfern zusammen. Darüber hinaus unterstützt Du den weiteren Aufbau einer modernen, internationalen Finanzorganisation.

  • Erstellung von Monats-, Quartals- und Jahresabschlüssen nach HGB und IFRS
  • Eigenverantwortliche Betreuung mehrerer Gesellschaften

  • Mitarbeit an der Konzernberichterstattung und Intercompany-Abstimmungen

  • Koordination und fachliche Begleitung bei Jahresabschluss- und Betriebsprüfungen
  • Mitarbeit bei der Weiterentwicklung unseres ERP-Systems Oracle NetSuite
  • Analyse und Optimierung von Accounting-Prozessen
  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit den Bereichen Controlling, Treasury und Operations

  • Mindestens fünf Jahre Berufserfahrung im Rechnungswesen, einschließlich fundierter, mehrjähriger Erfahrung in der eigenständigen Erstellung von Monats-, Quartals- und Jahresabschlüssen

description_html:
Deine Mission

Als Retail Promoter: arbeitest du freitags und samstags im Store und bist dort das Gesicht der Marke. Du begeisterst Kunden für innovative Consumer-Tech-Produkte, führst Produktdemonstrationen durch und unterstützt aktiv den Abverkauf im Handel.

Durch deine Beratung und Produktkenntnis sorgst du dafür, dass Kunden die Produkte erleben, verstehen und sich für einen Kauf entscheiden.

  • Aktive Ansprache von Kunden im Store und Begeisterung für die Produkte

  • Durchführung von Produktdemonstrationen und Beratungsgesprächen

  • Unterstützung beim Abverkauf und Förderung der Markenpräsenz im Store

  • Sicherstellung einer optimalen Präsentation der Produkte am Point of Sale

  • Erfassung deiner Aktivitäten und Ergebnisse über ein digitales Reporting-System

  • Weitergabe von Kundenfeedback und Marktinformationen an das Projektteam


Dein Profil

Du hast Freude daran, mit Menschen zu arbeiten, erklärst gerne Produkte und trittst offen und überzeugend auf. Die Rolle eignet sich besonders gut für Werkstudierende — du studierst nicht? Auch okay, die Stelle steht allen offen, die Lust auf den Job haben.

Experience & Education

  • Erste Erfahrung im Verkauf, Promotion, Retail oder Kundenservice von Vorteil

  • Interesse an Consumer-Tech-Produkten und neuen Technologien

  • Erfahrung im direkten Kundenkontakt ist ein Plus

  • Englischkenntnisse von Vorteil

  • Offene, kommunikative und serviceorientierte Persönlichkeit

  • Sicheres Auftreten und Begeisterungsfähigkeit im Kundengespräch

  • Grundlegender Umgang mit Smartphone / Apps für Reporting

  • Strukturierte und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise mit einer ausgeprägten Hands-on Mentalität

  • Fähigkeit, technische Produkte einfach und verständlich zu erklären und Kunden dafür zu begeistern


Warum Wir?

Bei uns arbeitest du für führende internationale Tech-Brands und bist direkt im Store aktiv.

  • Erlebe Innovation: Arbeite mit spannenden Consumer-Tech-Produkten

  • Direkter Kundenkontakt: Begeistere Menschen für neue Technologien

  • Team & Support: Werde Teil eines motivierten Promoter-Teams

  1. Culture Fit – Lerne unsere Talent Acquisition Managerin kennen. Hier erfährst du mehr über unser Unternehmen und unsere Kultur.

title: Embedded Software & Systems Consultant (all genders)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Invensity Group
description_html:
Welcome

Are you passionate about embedded software, industrial communication, and intelligent drive systems? Then join INVENSITY. Together with our customers, we develop innovative solutions for the next generation of industrial control and drive technologies and actively drive the digital transformation of industry.

Your contribution: You’ll develop and optimize software for modern controller platforms, variable-frequency drives, and servo drives. With your expertise in real-time communication, embedded systems, and industrial networks, you’ll lay the foundation for high-performance, reliable, and future-proof automation solutions.



What can you expect?

  • Help shape the next generation of intelligent IoT solutions by developing innovative software for open communication protocols and TSN (Time-Sensitive Networking) technologies on new and existing embedded platforms
  • Bring together various technologies by integrating, validating, and continuously optimizing third-party software components and modern communication stacks
  • Work in a modern, agile development environment based on model-driven methods, which gives you the opportunity to help shape holistic solutions that go beyond individual embedded platforms
  • Take on responsibility as part of a dedicated, agile team and actively contribute to the development of high-performance, reliable, and high-quality software products
  • Benefit from collaborating in interdisciplinary and international teams, exchange ideas with experts from a wide range of disciplines, and help shape innovative technologies in a global environment
  • Personal and professional development: Grow in a technologically leading environment, build connections, and help drive innovation across a wide variety of industries


Your profile

  • A successfully completed degree in computer science, electrical engineering, communications and information technology, or a comparable field
  • Several years of professional experience in hardware-oriented embedded software development using C/C++ under real-time operating systems (RTOS), as well as in-depth knowledge of Python and Git-based development environments
  • In-depth knowledge of Ethernet-based communication protocols such as TCP/IP, TLS, and PTP; ideally supplemented by experience with industry standards such as IEEE 1588, TSN, and X.509
  • Knowledge of C#, SQL, GoogleTest, and Jenkins, as well as experience with Azure DevOps/Pipelines, Visual Studio Code, or modern CI/CD processes, is a plus
  • Strong conceptual and analytical skills, as well as the ability to communicate complex technical issues to various stakeholders in a way that is tailored to their needs, understandable, and practical
  • Business-level proficiency in German and very good English skills




What are your benefits?

  • Structured onboarding: A clear onboarding plan, joint starting days with other new employees, and dedicated contact persons will support you from day one
  • Flexible working: Permanent employment contracts, flexible working hours, the option to work from home, part-time arrangements, and sabbatical opportunities
  • Global network: Collaboration with experts across our international locations
  • A unique working atmosphere and an appreciative corporate culture: Monthly office events, a first-name culture, short communication channels, and working towards shared goals
  • A steep learning curve: Varied responsibilities in an innovative environment, with diverse projects across different industries and clients
  • Personal and professional development: Individual mentoring and coaching, ACADEMY training courses, and an open feedback culture
  • Attractive career opportunities: Transparent career paths, the opportunity to take on responsibility quickly, and international career prospects
  • Performance-based compensation package: Fixed and variable salary components as well as assessments every six months




Good to know

Employment type: Permanent employment
Work model: Hybrid, combining remote work and office-based work
Workplace: Mannheim or Heidelberg


Your contact person

Sinja Seyfert

title: Tech Advisory Senior Consultant (m/w/d)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Trusteq Gmbh
description_html:
YOUR TASKS

As a Senior Consultant (m/f/d) in the Tech Advisory area, you will take on a key role in complex transformation projects. You will support our clients in the digital and organizational evolution of their business models and processes - from strategy development through to operational implementation.
You will work at the intersection of business, technology, and change management, applying agile methodologies in a targeted and effective way. In transformation projects, you will play a central role by bringing structure, clarity, and strong execution capabilities.

Your responsibilities will include a wide range of tasks:

  • Supporting transformation initiatives: Assisting clients in the structured development and optimization of organizations, processes, and ways of working
  • Interface management between business and IT: Gathering, structuring, and aligning business requirements while ensuring a shared understanding of project objectives
  • (Partial) project management: Independently planning, coordinating, and delivering projects with a strong focus on sustainable results
  • Applying agile methodologies: Using agile ways of working and taking on relevant roles (e.g. Scrum Master or Product Owner) within projects
  • Change management: Designing and supporting transformation processes, including stakeholder management and implementation support
  • Process analysis and optimization: Identifying improvement opportunities and developing as well as implementing efficient, digitally enabled processes
  • Management-level communication and reporting: Conducting structured analyses and preparing content tailored to decision-makers and steering committees


YOUR PROFIL

We are looking for people with drive, a strong sense of responsibility, and a clear affinity for technology and transformation.
What you should bring to the role:

  • A completed degree in (Business) Informatics, Engineering, Business Administration, or a comparable field of study
  • Several years of professional experience (at least 3–5 years) in management consulting or in transformation/digitalization projects
  • Certification in agile project management, ideally as a Scrum Master or Product Owner, as well as hands-on experience applying agile methodologies
  • Strong technological understanding: Ability to translate modern technologies (Cloud, Data & AI, Cybersecurity) into scalable IT architectures and digital platforms
  • Project management expertise: Experience managing (sub-)projects, including planning, steering, and stakeholder communication
  • Experience in transformation and change management: Ability to support organizational change in a structured way and ensure sustainable implementation
  • Strong analytical and strategic thinking skills combined with a pragmatic, solution-oriented working style
  • Excellent MS Office skills (especially PowerPoint and Excel), along with strong presentation and communication abilities
  • High level of initiative, strong teamwork skills, and a customer-oriented mindset
  • You have very good German and English language skills (minimum C1 level in both languages)


YOUR BENEFITS

  • Supportive Team Culture: Team cohesion is important to us - we support one another and foster a healthy office culture. Our event team organizes regular after-work events to encourage exchange and connection beyond the workplace.
  • Early Ownership & Responsibility: From day one, you will take on exciting tasks with real responsibility – whether on your project or by contributing to internal initiatives. You help shape the way we work.
  • Clear Career Development Paths: You will find an environment that supports, challenges, and advances your professional growth. We offer clearly defined career paths and a transparent competency framework for every level.
  • Creative Work Environment: We give you the freedom and time to develop creative solutions and provide the best, most modern hardware to support you (Apple or Windows).
  • Employee Benefits: Flexible working models, a BahnCard, JobRad, Spendit card, Wellpass, and a company pension scheme contribute to your well-being. In addition, you’ll enjoy the best coffee from our new espresso machine and a fully stocked soft drinks fridge in the office.
  • Attractive Vacation Policy: You benefit from 30 days of paid vacation per year and the flexibility to work from home.

description_html:
YOUR TASKS

  • You develop secure software and infrastructure solutions and integrate security-by-design principles into the development and deployment process from the very beginning.
  • You support our clients in the design, development, and protection of modern applications and infrastructures, for example in the areas of AI, web, APIs, and cloud.
  • You identify security risks in existing applications, cloud environments, and infrastructure configurations and derive concrete measures to remediate them.
  • You conduct code reviews with a focus on security and establish best practices for secure software development.
  • You work closely with development teams, architects, infrastructure teams, and security stakeholders to design secure systems holistically.
  • You implement security mechanisms such as authentication, authorization, encryption, and secrets management in software solutions and cloud configurations.
  • You integrate security checks into CI/CD pipelines and support the development of DevSecOps structures.
  • You develop and maintain infrastructure-as-code solutions to provision cloud and platform infrastructures securely, transparently, and repeatably.
  • You analyze new technologies and tools in the field of application security and actively contribute your ideas to client projects.
  • You support our clients in their transformation toward secure software development, modern architectures, and automated infrastructure processes.
  • You take ownership of your own work packages and actively contribute to the further development of our topics and services.


YOUR PROFIL

  • You have completed a degree with good to very good results in computer science, business information systems, IT security, or a comparable qualification.
  • You bring 1–2 years of professional experience for the Engineer role and 2–5 years for the Senior Engineer role.
  • You have solid knowledge of software development, for example Java, Python, TypeScript, or Go, and a strong interest in considering security from the very beginning.
  • You are familiar with cloud infrastructures, automation, and deployment processes.
  • You have experience with clean code, design patterns, and software quality, and can also apply these principles to automation and infrastructure code.
  • You are familiar with version control, especially Git, and code reviews.
  • You know common secure coding practices and have a good understanding of typical vulnerabilities, such as the OWASP Top 10.
  • You have knowledge of container technologies, such as Docker and Kubernetes, and how to secure them.
  • You have practical experience with infrastructure as code or would like to deepen your existing knowledge in this area. Ideally, you have already worked with tools such as Terraform, OpenTofu, or Pulumi.
  • You have experience with automated testing, for example unit, integration, and security tests, and are also familiar with approaches for the automated validation of infrastructure configurations.
  • Ideally, you have already worked with DevSecOps approaches and integrated security into development and deployment processes across AWS, Azure, or GCP.
  • Ideally, you understand modern security architectures, such as zero trust, least privilege, and defense in depth.
  • Ideally, you already hold certifications in the field of security.
  • You think not only technically but also analytically, and can assess and prioritize security risks in a structured way.
  • You enjoy familiarizing yourself with new technologies and security topics and continuously developing your knowledge.
  • You enjoy working in a team, take responsibility for your topics, and drive them forward independently.
  • You communicate confidently in German and English and can explain complex topics clearly, including when interacting with clients.
  • You do not just want to implement solutions, but actively help shape them and contribute to real success in projects and in building new topics.

description_html:
Deine Aufgaben

Bloombase baut die führende ERP-Plattform für Cannabis-Apotheken in Deutschland. Gegründet mit dem Full-Stack-Know-how von SnapNext und dem Branchenrückhalt von Cannamedical – einem der größten Cannabis-Konzerne im deutschsprachigen Raum – entwickeln wir eine B2B-Software, die das Cannabis-Business bei uns und unseren Kunden grundlegend neu strukturiert. 
Wir sind klein, bewegen uns schnell und treffen Entscheidungen pragmatisch. Du steigst früh ein, gestaltest die Company aktiv mit und arbeitest in einem modernen Startup-Umfeld – mit der Sicherheit und dem Rückhalt einer etablierten Unternehmensgruppe im Rücken. 

  • Du entwickelst unsere ERP-Kernmodule mit – Inventarverwaltung, Auftragsabwicklung per Stapelverarbeitung, digitale Rezeptabwicklung und rollenbasierte Dashboards – über den gesamten Stack hinweg
  • Du baust und pflegst die Schnittstellen, über die eine einzige Anbindung unsere Kunden mit allen Telemedizin-Plattformen und Versanddienstleistern (z. B. DHL, UPS) verbindet
  • Du sorgst dafür, dass Audit-Sicherheit, lückenlose Protokollierung und DSGVO-Konformität sauber im Code verankert sind – bei uns Kernanforderung, kein Nachgedanke
  • Du schreibst wartbaren, getesteten Code, nimmst an Code Reviews teil und entwickelst unsere Standards mit weiter
  • Du behältst die Skalierbarkeit im Blick, damit die Software auch bei steigendem Bestellvolumen schnell und stabil bleibt



Dein Profil

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der professionellen Softwareentwicklung
  • Fundierte Kenntnisse im Stack: Frontend mit React, Backend mit Node.js (NestJS) und durchgängig JavaScript/TypeScript
  • Erfahrung mit relationalen Datenbanken und Datenmodellierung
